supersedes: Day 2 15-case escalation-only golden set (now deprecated — do not use the old file as a separate eval source; all escalation cases are consolidated here)
known_limitations: LLM judge grades citation-consistency, not raw-chunk faithfulness — judge never sees actual retrieved chunk text, only citation metadata. Real evidentiary faithfulness against source text is not currently verified.
Negation check is a 40-character fixed-width lookback heuristic. Width is hand-tuned to known cases, not principled. Double negatives, split-sentence negation, and sarcasm are untested.
No production sampling plan — new failure patterns from real usage are not automatically added to the golden set.
No model/prompt version pinning — if claude-sonnet-4-6 is replaced, results are not comparable without a re-baseline.
